description:
These yellow gutka brick tiles for kitchen walls are handmade, natural-finish brick tiles in a pale yellow tone, used to give a kitchen or feature wall the look of exposed brick without building a full brick wall.

## How they look
Gutka tiles are thin brick-face tiles. Because these are handmade, each piece has slight variation in edge and tone, which gives the wall an honest, rustic texture. The yellow shade is lighter and softer than the classic red gutka, so it suits kitchens that already have warm wood or cream cabinets.

## Where they work
- **Kitchen feature walls and backsplash areas** away from direct flame.
- **Dining and lounge accent walls**, where a light brick tone brightens the room.
- **Interior walls in cafés and restaurants**, for a traditional brick look.

For red brick, see the [red gutka bricks wall tiles](/products/red-gutka-bricks-living-room-wall-tiles), and read [red vs yellow gutka bricks](/blog/red-gutka-bricks-vs-yellow-gutka-bricks-which-to-pick) to compare.

## Good to know
Natural clay is porous, so in a kitchen a breathable clear sealer is usually applied after fixing to help with oil and stains. Fix with a tile adhesive or mortar on a level wall, and keep joints consistent for a neat brick bond.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the shade in your light, then get a dated quote for your wall.

faqs.q: What is the price of yellow gutka tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can gutka tiles be used in a kitchen?
faqs.a: Yes, on walls away from direct flame. Clay is porous, so a breathable clear sealer is usually applied in kitchens to make oil and stains easier to clean.

faqs.q: Red or yellow gutka tiles: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Red gives a classic, darker brick look and suits exteriors and bold feature walls; yellow is lighter and softer and suits kitchens and smaller rooms. Seeing both samples side by side is the easiest way to decide.
